top_signals.title: US 10-Year Yields Climb to Highest Since 2025 as Rout Deepens
top_signals.summary: A deepening global bond selloff sent the US benchmark yield to the highest since early 2025, as thin August trading met investors wary of inflation and a deluge of corporate debt supply.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Top East Africa Bourse Plans ETF Push to Tap Investor Demand
top_signals.summary: East Africa’s biggest bourse plans to offer a variety of exchange-traded funds to meet demand from investors, Nairobi Securities Exchange Chief Executive Officer Frank Mwiti said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Meta faces ‘astronomical’ consequences as legal fight reaches critical moment in California
top_signals.summary: Meta faces a federal trial over child safety claims that could bring major financial penalties and changes to Facebook and Instagram.

top_signals.title: India’s Digital Payments Boom Fails to Dent Demand for Cash
top_signals.summary: India’s rapid adoption of digital payments has failed to curb demand for cash, making it harder to predict how much currency will be needed, Reserve Bank of India Deputy Governor Shirish Chandra Murmu said.

top_signals.title: Tankers U-Turn at Hormuz as Iran Tightens Its Grip
top_signals.summary: Tanker traffic at the Strait of Hormuz has become even more erratic than before, with vessels meandering and U-turning, unsure how to proceed amid escalating security threats and Iran’s insistence of control over the chokepoint. The Amara fuel tanker, which moved into the Persian Gulf empty on Monday, has since made several U-turns and is currently positioned without moving in the northern part of the Strait of Hormuz in lanes where Iran approves transits, according to vessel-tracking data compiled by Bloomberg.
